theorems.name: Submission.fiw_tb_ext_mass_le_restrictDomain
theorems.statement: ∀ (P q : ℕ) (U K : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∀ Z : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) q, (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) q, Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) q)) K → Z ω = 0) → Z.mass ≤ (Z.restrictDomain (subset_univ U)).mass
